Bright midday sunlight throws strong tree shadows across a compact New York brownstone block, softened by light atmospheric haze. Two narrow asphalt streets meet at a right angle, with concrete curbs and sidewalks beneath roughly fifteen tightly spaced three- to five-story row houses and small apartment buildings. Slight variations in height and setback interrupt a nearly continuous street wall.

Predominantly weathered red brick is joined by occasional brownstone and pale stone façades, dark-painted trim, flat parapet roofs, and a few mansard or stepped-gable profiles. Repetitive sash windows, shutters, projecting bays, cornices, window air conditioners, fire escapes, basement openings, and raised stoops with ornate black iron railings give the buildings their detail.

Mature leafy street trees in guards, small planted front areas, benches, and American flags furnish the sidewalks. Crosswalks, dashed lane lines, manholes, and scattered fallen leaves mark the roads. Curved streetlamps, blue mailboxes, hydrants, refuse bins, and street signs accompany a yellow taxi, a van, and a dark sedan.

clauses.text: Bright midday sunlight throws strong tree shadows across a compact New York brownstone block, softened by light atmospheric haze
Two narrow asphalt streets meet at a right angle, with concrete curbs and sidewalks beneath roughly fifteen tightly spaced three- to five-story row houses and small apartment buildings
Slight variations in height and setback interrupt a nearly continuous street wall
Predominantly weathered red brick is joined by occasional brownstone and pale stone façades, dark-painted trim, flat parapet roofs, and a few mansard or stepped-gable profiles

Repetitive sash windows, shutters, projecting bays, cornices, window air conditioners, fire escapes, basement openings, and raised stoops with ornate black iron railings give the buildings their detail
Mature leafy street trees in guards, small planted front areas, benches, and American flags furnish the sidewalks
Crosswalks, dashed lane lines, manholes, and scattered fallen leaves mark the roads
Curved streetlamps, blue mailboxes, hydrants, refuse bins, and street signs accompany a yellow taxi, a van, and a dark sedan
